    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))

    return str(path.relative_to(root)).replace("\\", "/")

    path = out / name

        raise RuntimeError("单次解释产物已存在，禁止重复：" + rel(path))
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return {"path": rel(path), "sha256": digest(path)}

assert digest(out / "protocol.json") == "9fe0d686e142e6e56ee04295e7c4feb4f7d7f0e090d164aad637a40a556d69a7"
for parent in protocol["parents"]:
